notes.title: New version demo developer live stream!
notes.notes:
After last month's Next Festival, we made significant optimizations to the game based on feedback and suggestions from players!
We have resolved the issues of archiving and resolution adaptation that everyone mentioned, made significant modifications to the UI, reduced performance consumption, and comprehensively upgraded the visual performance.
In addition to these optimized contents, we have also added new gameplay such as a crime system and a member management system. We have also added many plot tasks and other exploratory content for each county in the open area of this trial version. Come and take a look at the changes!

notes.title: June 12th Update logs
notes.notes:
Updated on June 12th
In order to better spread their ideas and concepts, the Nine Schools of Thought require their scholars not to be too difficult for all scholars who come to study
(Optimized the presentation of the Study game)
-Fixed the issue where enemies would be in a walking state after a duel in some cases
-Fixed the issue where some weapon strikes could cause camera misalignment
-Fixed the issue where some temporary features did not disappear properly
-Optimized some memory usage
We are aware of the feedback and suggestions regarding UI interface, resolution adaptation, performance optimization, and archiving rules.
We will take it seriously and solve it seriously, and notify everyone promptly once we have specific solutions!
Finally, please add a wish list to support us! Thank you!

notes.title: June 11th Update logs
notes.notes:
Updated on June 11th
-Fixed the issue of ineffective "Treasure form sky" feature in some cases
-Fixed the issue where the task dashboard could not refresh properly in some cases
-Fixed an issue where some equipment attribute bonuses did not match the description
-Fixed the issue of no normal feedback after successful gift giving

We will keep updating to solve various problems that arise in the game, optimize the player experience, and add new content!

notes.title: Now supports English!And will continue to update！
notes.notes:
At present, our game already supports English, but it is still in the development stage and does not represent the final translation quality. 
We will also continue to address in-game issures and improve performance optimization next week.
Please add a wishlist to support us！Thank you！

notes.title: 《Age of HuaXia:Warring States》Demo first update！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/7d2917e8d8c2585137142183984e4da5b36b5c97.jpg[/img]
6/1版本更新内容

再次感谢大家的积极反馈！
我们将在这段时间持续修复游戏问题，优化体验，以及添加更多的游戏内容！
还请大家保持关注！


-修复了以下问题：

·队伍扈从升级模型报错
·场景中角色重新加载模型报错
·休息到临界状态值时无限跳转
·大世界中队伍追击距离过远
·食物叠加上限过少
·行商小队不能正确出现
·封邑通行权导致国人不能正常进入房屋等场景


-增加了部分新内容以及优化了部分玩法的体验：

任务：

·支线任务增加使对应交互可进行的特性（论道、切磋、求教）
·修正部分任务文本内容
·问剑任务流程优化
世界：

·在野外增加行商小队，可与各类商人交互购买物品
·减少野外黑市捕奴队的数量
·调整杂货商的商品内容，增加护甲维修道具，增加食物
·调整武器商人的商品内容，增加白色品质武器
·调整野外队伍追击参数，降低野外队伍追击移动速度
·增加部分场景首次进入时的演绎：城门守卫（调整）、商业区

宗族封邑：

·修正巩县封邑错误的NPC位置
·修正巩县封邑场景对国人身份的限制，不再阻止国人玩家进入建筑
·增加巩县封邑庄园中的任务交互物
·增加了巩县封邑场景内的奴人英雄

交互：

·新增了一些UI音效
·优化说服离开房间的名称和功能描述
·开放国人身份招揽其他英雄为队友的交互

数值：
·取消违禁品设定， 避免玩家触发被没收背包的流程
·负重等级为低时的野外旅行饱食度消耗降低
·修正脱离奴人奖励获得的衣物可能导致界面崩溃的问题
·修正修理工具道具的负重值、好感度价值
·提高了钱币的好感度价值
